title: Instant e-PAN
section: * OTP will be valid for 15 minutes only.   * You have 3 attempts to enter the correct OTP.   * The OTP expiry countdown timer on screen tells you when the OTP will expire.   * On clicking Resend OTP, a new OTP will be generated and sent.  **Step 5:** On the View / Download e-PAN page, you will be able to see the status of your e-PAN request. In case the new e-PAN has been generated and allotted, click View e-PAN to view or Download e-PAN to download a copy.  **4.Related Topics**   * _Register for e-Filing (Taxpayer)_   * _Dashboard and Worklist_   * _Login_   * _Verify your PAN_   * _Link Aadhaar_   * _Know your PAN_
